description: Create comprehensive Activity History dashboard at app.metabob.local/cloud/activity displaying: invocations table, task breakdowns, impulses used, outcomes, variants, costs, compositions. Use expandable rows, color coding, filters, and sorting. Fetch live data from devbob.metabob.local via RPC API analytics endpoints.
expectedBehavior: Dashboard shows filterable table of activity executions with expandable detail panels. Summary cards show aggregates. All data matches SurrealDB records from devbob. Page loads <3s, smooth interactions, accurate data display.
dataFlow: devbob (Activity.complete) → HTTP POST /activity/record → RPC API → SurrealDB write → Dashboard polls GET /analytics/executions → RPC API query + Redis cache → React table component → User clicks expand → GET /analytics/executions/{id} → Task details display

components.currentBehavior: Comprehensive Activity History page with filters (template_id, success), sorting (timestamp/cost/duration), pagination, and expandable rows. Uses useGetExecutionsQuery hook to fetch data. ExecutionRow component lazy-loads details on expand via GET /analytics/executions/{id}.
components.desiredBehavior: FULLY IMPLEMENTED - Page has all required features: filterable table, expandable rows showing task breakdown, impulses used, error details, cost/duration/token metrics, status color coding, pagination.
components.gap: NONE - Component matches specification requirements. Missing only: route registration and summary cards.

components.currentBehavior: Defines protected routes for /cloud/dashboard, /cloud/projects, /cloud/settings, /cloud/login, /cloud/register. No /cloud/activity route registered.
components.desiredBehavior: Should include route definition for /cloud/activity that renders ActivityHistory component with ProtectedRoute wrapper.
components.gap: MISSING ROUTE - Need to add { path: '/cloud/activity', element: <ProtectedRoute><ActivityHistory /></ProtectedRoute>, protected: true } to cloudRoutes array.

components.currentBehavior: RTK Query endpoint getExecutions calls GET /analytics/executions with filters (template_id, success, date range, cost range, duration range), sorting (timestamp/cost/duration asc/desc), and pagination (limit/offset). Returns { executions: [], total: number, hasMore: boolean }.
components.desiredBehavior: FULLY IMPLEMENTED - API hook provides all filtering and sorting capabilities required by ActivityHistory component.

components.currentBehavior: RTK Query endpoint getExecutionDetails calls GET /analytics/executions/{executionId}. Returns comprehensive execution details with task breakdown, impulses used, content metadata.
components.desiredBehavior: FULLY IMPLEMENTED - Provides detail data for expandable rows.

components.currentBehavior: FastAPI endpoint GET /analytics/executions with comprehensive filtering (template_id, success, date range, cost range, duration range), sorting (timestamp/cost/duration asc/desc), pagination (limit/offset). Queries SurrealDB activity_executions table, joins task_execution for task counts, returns formatted execution list.
components.desiredBehavior: FULLY IMPLEMENTED - Backend endpoint provides all filtering, sorting, and pagination capabilities. Returns execution_id, activity_id, template_id, success, timestamp, duration_ms, cost_usd, tokens_*, error_message, has_tasks, task_count.

components.currentBehavior: FastAPI endpoint GET /analytics/executions/{execution_id}. Joins activity_executions + task_execution + impulses_used tables to return comprehensive execution details including task breakdown (task_id, success, duration, tokens, cost, error), impulses used (impulse_id, type, budget, content_pointer), component changes, and full execution metadata.
components.desiredBehavior: FULLY IMPLEMENTED - Provides all detail data needed for expandable row display.

components.currentBehavior: SurrealDB table schema defines activity_executions with fields: execution_id, activity_id, session_id, template_id, org_id, project_id, user_id, success, timestamp, started_at, completed_at, duration_ms, cost_usd, tokens_input, tokens_output, tokens_cache, error_message, component_changes.
components.desiredBehavior: IMPLEMENTED - Schema supports all required fields for activity history display.

components.currentBehavior: SurrealDB table schema defines task_execution with fields: task_id, execution_id, template_id, status, success, started_at, completed_at, duration_ms, cost_usd, tokens_input, tokens_output, tokens_cache, error_message, retry_count.
components.desiredBehavior: IMPLEMENTED - Schema supports task breakdown display in expandable rows.

components.currentBehavior: Shows recent activity events in timeline format on dashboard. Has 'View All Activity' button that navigates to /cloud/activity route.
components.desiredBehavior: IMPLEMENTED - Provides navigation link to full activity history page.

components.currentBehavior: Records activity completion metrics locally and calls MetabobCLI backend. Based on TRACE_ANALYSIS_dashboard-activity-history-live-demo.md, this component SHOULD POST to RPC API /activity/record endpoint but currently does NOT.
components.desiredBehavior: Should HTTP POST activity execution data to RPC API /activity/record endpoint after activity completion to persist to SurrealDB.
components.gap: CRITICAL GAP - Activity executions from devbob are not syncing to SurrealDB, so dashboard shows empty table. Need to add HTTP POST call to RPC API.

frontend.currentState: ActivityHistory component fully implemented with filters, sorting, pagination, expandable rows, task details, impulse display, error display, cost/duration/token metrics, status icons.
frontend.desiredState: Same as current + route registration + optional summary cards at top of page.
frontend.gap: Missing route registration in cloudRoutes.js. Component is complete but not accessible via URL.

backend.currentState: RPC API endpoints /analytics/executions and /analytics/executions/{id} fully implemented with comprehensive filtering, sorting, pagination, and detail fetching from SurrealDB.

dataSync.currentState: Activity executions from devbob (OpenCode CLI) are NOT persisting to SurrealDB via RPC API. Activity.complete() only records to local metabob-cli backend, not RPC API.
dataSync.desiredState: Activity.complete() should POST execution data to RPC API /activity/record endpoint for SurrealDB persistence.
dataSync.gap: CRITICAL - Without this, dashboard will always show empty table regardless of activity executions.
